name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Either Choir goes with Frost or Yearbook goes with Boyd.

Cloister, Studio, and Workshop go with Rowing, Scouts, and Yearbook, in some order.
Hale goes with none of Annex, Workshop, or Debate.
Boyd, Bungalow, and Debate belong to different classes.
